Alfresa Holdings Corporation
is a major Japanese healthcare and pharmaceutical wholesale group that distributes medical devices and pharmaceuticals, but
it does not directly manufacture consumer continuous glucose monitors, smartwatches, wearable ECGs, or proprietary sleep trackers
. However, the broader digital health and remote patient monitoring (RPM) sector heavily utilizes these exact wearable technologies.
